observations: Red rectangular industrial steam iron base unit with white control panel.
Control panel labeled 'MAXIFER familiare' with 'Culdaia' and 'Ferro' sections, each with a red switch and power ratings: W.1000 V.220 and W.800 V.220.
Text 'Made in Italy' visible on the right side of the control panel.
Black handle on top, black knob on left side, and various hoses and connectors.
White iron head with a silver soleplate and black control knob, connected by a hose.
Cables and power plug visible, coiled on the table.
Photos show the unit from three angles: front, side, and angled top view.
Watermark 'RESURRECTION LIGHT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: The brand name on the unit is 'MAXIFER', not 'Ponybaby'. 'Made in Italy' is visible on the control panel, so 'Italian' is supported, but 'Ponybaby' is not present in any photo.

claims.claim: All our products are tested under stress and we...
claims.evidence: No visual evidence of testing or stress testing is shown in the photos. This claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on, water boiling, steam output, and iron head heating.

risks.risk: The power cord or internal wiring may be damaged or unsafe.
risks.proof: Close-up of the power cord, plug, and internal wiring connections.

risks.risk: The iron head may be damaged or have a non-functional thermostat.
risks.proof: Close-up of the iron head soleplate and control knob, and a video of the iron heating up.

proof_requests: Video of the unit in operation: power on, steam output, and iron heating.
Close-up of the power cord, plug, and internal wiring.
Close-up of the iron head soleplate and control knob.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a MAXIFER familiare industrial steam iron, but critical functional and safety risks cannot be assessed from the current photos. The seller's claim of 'Ponybaby' is contradicted by the visible brand name. Proof of operation and condition is required before pricing.
